text:
alex: Heads up 1: CipherGrid reached out about listing their HSM-backed KMS in our marketplace and doing a small joint announcement. They want a "light" integration guide + a security validation window next Thurs. Can we run a quick readiness pass? @ravi @leah @natalie

 ravi: Security checklist quick notes: need HSM module cert (module ID + FIPS cert), KMS REST surface doc, support for key wrapping/non-exportable keys, and confirmation of HSM attestation method (remote attestation preferred). Also ask for their CA chain for mTLS.

 leah: Legal/marketing: we'll need a co-marketing addendum and logo usage terms. Also confirm embargo window; prefer 72h if partner is doing press. Can the partner sign our standard marketplace partner terms or do they need redlines?

 natalie: Ops/devex items: what form does their connector take? Docker-based agent or k8s helm? We need a deployment matrix (ports, env vars, resource reqs). If they provide helm chart that's ideal. For the dry-run, request a staging image tag and a test HSM simulator or remote dev HSM credentials.

 alex: From product POV: We want to list two SKUs: "CipherGrid KMS (on-prem)" and "CipherGrid KMS (cloud proxy)" so we need clear feature matrix. Also compatibility notes: supported key algorithms, max key size, and latency SLAs.

 ravi: Minimum ask to CipherGrid: 1) KMS OpenAPI spec (or sample requests), 2) HSM attestation artifacts (firmware hash + module ID), 3) CA certs for mTLS, 4) key export policy statement.

 leah: I'll draft the addendum and push to them. Can someone draft the 2-line joint announcement copy? Marketing prefers a 2-3 sentence blurb + one customer quote (optional).

 natalie: Devex will draft integration docs. Quick SCIM mapping sample we can validate with them: 
```
scim:users:
  id: "externalId"
  userName: "emails[0].value"
  name: displayName
  active: true
```
And SAML sample request is needed for SP metadata.

 alex: CI note: please run connector smoke tests in our staging marketplace cluster. @ci-bot kick off tests after we get the staging image.

 ci-bot: Triggered pipeline: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/6789  connector-smoke-tests queued.

 ravi: One extra: banks ask for key zeroization policy and tamper evidence statement. Ask CipherGrid for whitepaper or SOC2-type attestation.

 alex: Action list: 
- ravi: send requirements email to CipherGrid (owner: ravi)  due Tue EOD (2812410000).
- leah: draft co-marketing addendum + embargo language (owner: leah)  due Wed.
- natalie: prepare staging checklist and sample SCIM/SAML examples (owner: natalie)  first draft Thu morning.
- alex: create marketplace SKU stubs and request feature matrix from partner (owner: alex)  due Fri.

 leah: Also ask if CipherGrid supports HSM cluster replication and which models they certify. Some customers will require model whitelist.

 natalie: I'll request a simulated HSM endpoint if they can't share real HSM creds for security reasons. That should be enough for integration tests.

 alex: Great. I'll email Ameya (CipherGrid PM) now to lock dates. If we get attestation artifacts + legal signed, target joint announcement in ~3 weeks.

 ravi: Flag: if firmware hash or FIPS certs are missing, we won't be able to greenlight the "on-prem" SKU. Will revisit.

 leah: Noted. Will make the addendum conditional on security artifacts.

 alex: Thanks everyone. Will post updates here after Ameya replies. :thumbsup:
